Actual popup selections, shared seek/draw/move/resize snap, OPR v17 round-trip and legacy defaults pass headless tests. Full reference menu layout and live user check pending. T009 makes implemented field captions/arrows high contrast, verified from emitted text in both themes; actual popup/menu regressions pass. Live toolbar appearance pending.

requirements.outcome: Transport panel grouping, numeric displays, editable tempo/signature controls, contiguous buttons and left/right edges follow the primary crop with OpenTrack palette.
CLICK, remappable C and Transport menu toggle the same state; Setup adjusts level and downbeat pitch with left/right controls; settings persist globally without editing Project.
Short pop click accents the chosen pitch with octave-lower other beats, follows tempo/signature/cycle/skip sample clock, bypasses Stereo Out processing/meter and does not enter recording capture.
requirements.implementation_note: Click now enters device output after Stereo Out processing and meter publication. Live sound and device path require review; wider non-4/4 Project ruler/grid mapping remains incomplete.

requirements.outcome: Transport allows tempo entry/drag and time-signature editing; the bar-position readout carries tick 100 into the next subdivision and displays two tick digits.
requirements.implementation_note: Tempo can be typed/dragged in the Transport; signature field opens project numerator/denominator controls. Edits rebuild audio plan and preserve the current beat. Position ticks are fixed-width 00-99 and carry across subdivisions, beats and bars. Non-4/4 arrangement rulers and grids are not corrected by this slice.

requirements.outcome: Ctrl+C copies selected Project timeline audio events; Ctrl+V creates new selected events at the transport cursor while preserving relative timing, track spacing, source trims/fades/gain, and Undo/Redo.
requirements.implementation_note: In-app transient clipboard; no WAV byte duplication. Core paste transaction allocates fresh IDs and retains source paths in Media Pool. Destination lane row spacing and channel widths are validated atomically. Ctrl+P Media Pool remains unchanged. No T032 tests were run.

requirements.outcome: Clicking Pitch & Time on the active event starts cancellable Rust analysis for its source range; import, playback, project open and ordinary Sample Editor open do not analyze audio.
requirements.implementation_note: Explicit worker with cancellation, source/event snapshot validation, persisted source/range/detector identity and no eager job on reopening saved analysis.

requirements.outcome: Show source-relative voiced pitch estimates over the event waveform with a pitch axis; unvoiced frames break the trace.
requirements.implementation_note: True measured trace, separate keyboard, subdued waveform, editable note region outlines, selected coloring and curve preview; visual parity remains pending.

requirements.outcome: Reuse analyzed source/range results across shared event copies and save/reopen without eager reanalysis; reject stale source/model results.
requirements.implementation_note: OPR v26 retains analysis plus immediate edit intent and restores without eager analysis. Source/range/detector identity remains; initial analysis survives edit Undo. Cross-event external mirror lookup remains unimplemented.

requirements.outcome: Segment real analysis into editable note regions with stable event intent and undoable boundary/split/join operations.
requirements.implementation_note: Bodies now change pitch only, snapping absolute center; Shift+left fine-tunes continuously at 0.1 sensitivity and targets that note. Timing stays with edge stretches. Selection and epsilon-touching constraints do not mutate or panic. Live intent/gesture history and analysis retention remain.

requirements.outcome: Pitch edits create an audible, reversible processed result while preserving original source audio and Project/Mixer/export consistency.
requirements.implementation_note: Prepared immutable pitch-synchronous PlaybackSource samples original decoded memory directly with bounded callback work. Edits take effect without output files; original/corrected comparison and Project/Mixer routing share intent. Hardware latency/CPU/dropouts, vocal quality, processed-waveform regeneration and export remain pending.

requirements.outcome: Local time anchors/ratios produce audible time correction in Pitch & Time, preserving source originals and reversible event intent; no separate AudioWarp feature.
requirements.implementation_note: Note source/destination anchors and edge stretches update a live stateless source without bouncing. Whole-event length remains fixed; interior anchors, consonants/transients, detailed processed-waveform presentation and real-vocal listening remain pending.

requirements.outcome: Lower-right vertical zoom adjusts semitone row height around the same pitch center, with vertical range navigation. Middle-drag or Shift+wheel pans pitch; Ctrl+Shift+wheel zooms pitch. Plain wheel and horizontal middle pan retain timeline navigation. View state persists without editing project audio.

A lower-right Project control and keyboard zoom share persisted vertical track scaling; Shift+wheel scrolls tracks, Ctrl+Shift+wheel zooms them, and middle drag pans the arrange view in both directions.
Project time, Project track and Sample Editor pitch zoom share the chosen Sample Editor thumb/rail, hover/drag accent, +/- buttons and reset behavior.
Measure absolute cents/voicing/octave/timing error at declared resolution on known sources and labeled real monophonic vocals; distinguish synthetic confidence from real singing accuracy.
Pitch & Time gestures target notes; scissors never split or create Project audio events.
Pitch/time movement immediately updates original-source playback without Apply or creating output audio files; source samples remain intact.
requirements.implementation_note: A dedicated preview voice loops the held note's current pitch/time source directly to device output with a 5 ms fade-in and source-change crossfade. It works with the transport stopped and does not move the playhead or rebuild the project plan. Release stops the voice and the control thread clears it after the fade. Live listening is pending.

requirements.outcome: Each pitch/time gesture, including resetting multiple selected notes, is one reversible Project edit; analysis remains available through Undo/Redo and exact native save/reopen.
Bottom-quarter note hover shows a snapped white cut guide and scissors; nearby proximity reveals only a subtle white allowed-span affordance.
A compact wider fixed Inspector fits the normal lower zone, with no scrolling text panel and no grid wheel action from that panel.
Separate sustained notes connected by upward/downward slides while preserving ordinary vibrato, with manual repair retained.
White event selection/fade/gain guides, descriptive hover tooltips and selected-event fade/gain editing with cancellation and one-gesture Undo.

Event-name double-click renames the actual audio file, updates shared references/unprocessed copy labels, preserves processed variation labels, rejects collisions, and supports Undo/Redo/discard/restart recovery.

Plain body drag changes pitch only and snaps the absolute center; Shift held before or pressed during a body drag latches continuous sub-semitone correction without a pitch jump and shows cents from the nearest semitone; body movement never changes timing.
Selecting and dragging touching notes tolerates floating-point seams; invalid time bounds preserve existing values rather than panicking.
Dragging from empty Sample Editor grid selects intersected note regions without editing project state; Reset restores all selected notes as one Undo and keeps adjacent regions valid.

Stretching a note boundary moves the adjoining note?s nearest edge inward or outward when the regions were attached; far edges stay fixed, pre-existing gaps remain open until crossed, and both regions retain at least 10 ms.

Double-clicking one note edge restores that edge to its source boundary; double-clicking the note body restores analyzed pitch and source timing. The reset preserves analysis and is published as an undoable project edit.
Native OPR save/reopen restores exact split note identity, analysis, source/destination boundaries, pitch and timing without scheduling analysis again.
Pitch correction on controlled vocal sources avoids the reported bubbly/poppy artifacts while preserving original media and musical accuracy.
requirements.implementation_note: The audited hard wet-to-dry switch at edge-only endpoints now crossfades over 5 ms. Audio handoff is a 5 ms boundary crossfade instead of a full-ramp two-voice blend, and one-unchanged-note pairs use the unchanged edge pitch. Sample-continuity and single-voice tests pass. Grain-phase and confidence-mix hypotheses remain unproven; user listening is pending.

requirements.outcome: Pitch targets ease toward the connected note inside each edited note for at most one sixteenth-note, with an audible seam blend and no Project event changes.
requirements.implementation_note: The audio handoff is now 5 ms around the boundary while pitch ramps still reach at most one sixteenth-note. One-unchanged-note pairs meet at the unchanged edge pitch. Endpoint and single-voice tests pass; live listening is pending.

requirements.outcome: Project event hover above the black name strip exposes a contextual cut zone that splits at the actual snapped guide.
Project and Sample Editor show scissors alone when Snap is off and pencil alone for loop/skip drawing; snapped cut cursor follows the committed guide.
Project and Sample Editor share plain-wheel time zoom, Ctrl+wheel horizontal scroll, Shift+wheel vertical scroll and Ctrl+Shift+wheel vertical zoom.
Mixer fader caps are rectangular and clicking a Mixer channel selects the same shared track in Project and Inspector.
Unselected pitch notes use the color of their current rounded semitone row and selected notes use the track color, including after pitch, fine-tune, split and time-only edits.
requirements.implementation_note: Palette index is round(detected_midi + shift) clamped to MIDI 0..127. Selected fill and outline use project_controls::track_color; the blue fallback is test-only. Focused editing and Sample Editor suites pass; live visual review pending.

requirements.outcome: Project/Mixer meters, Channel Settings EQ parameters and response graph, and the channel spectrum inherit the channel's track color; Stereo In/Out default to blue and are color-selectable without audio-plan changes.
requirements.implementation_note: Meters, EQ parameter bars, response curve/nodes and the owned spectrum use the channel color; red over-unity and the orange comparison trace remain. Stereo In/Out use a blue default and expose the palette selector in the Mixer footer. Live visual review is pending.

dirty-state.description: Seeking/view activity does not create an unintended save prompt.

range-persistence.description: Range content survives native save/reopen and its edits follow documented undo/dirty semantics.

audible-boundaries.description: Cycle and skip execute at correct audio boundaries with cursor/audio agreement.

accepted-ui.description: Affected accepted Mixer and Project controls pass regression checks.

transport-panel-review.description: Same-display current capture and full-edge visual comparison of the compact panel, actual buttons, meters and output slider are reviewed.

metronome-listening.description: Target-device audible pop timbre, level, clock/loop/skip behavior, recording isolation, restart preferences and Project grid alignment (including non-4/4) are qualified.

audio-event-clipboard-review.description: Single and multi-event Ctrl+C/Ctrl+V, cursor placement, channel-width validation, playback, and Undo/Redo pass live checks.

pitch-time-analysis-review.description: No eager work; actual analysis result and confidence/voicing presentation; cancel, event-switch stale rejection, original-audio integrity and runtime behavior pass on real monophonic audio.

project-track-navigation-review.description: Verify vertical control, keyboard zoom, Shift+wheel scroll, Ctrl+Shift+wheel zoom, middle-drag pan, and ordinary Project seek/zoom on the live app.

pitch-time-render-review.description: Live note edits, real-vocal listening, stereo/transient/seam/formant behavior, Undo/Redo, save/reopen and failure/cancel/source-integrity checks pass.

project-event-batch-editing-review.description: User verifies the complete T039 interaction, audio/filesystem, Undo/save/reopen/discard scenario on the target build.

audio-source-renaming-review.description: User verifies the complete T039 interaction, audio/filesystem, Undo/save/reopen/discard scenario on the target build.

pitch-note-editing-batch1-review.description: User verifies fine pitch/cents, note marquee, selected Reset/Undo, neighbor-pushing stretches, double-click reset and exact OPR reopen in the built app; close the app afterward.

pitch-processing-listening-review.description: User checks the current build with their own audio for pitch quality, in-note transitions (at most one sixteenth-note), and time-shrink bubbling/chopping before Batch3 begins.

project-mixer-interaction-review.description: User verifies contextual Project cuts, Snap-dependent cursor artwork, shared wheel bindings, rectangular Mixer faders and shared channel selection on the built app.
